mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_feedback_content( source_id,description,function_module,problem_type,feedback_tags,reproducibility,mapping_rule_version, normalization_version,masking_status,data_quality_score,quality_rule_version ) VALUES( #{sourceId},#{description},#{functionModule},#{problemType},#{feedbackTags},#{reproducibility},#{mappingRuleVersion}, #{normalizationVersion},#{maskingStatus},#{dataQualityScore},#{qualityRuleVersion} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE description=VALUES(description),function_module=VALUES(function_module),problem_type=VALUES(problem_type), feedback_tags=VALUES(feedback_tags),reproducibility=VALUES(reproducibility), mapping_rule_version=VALUES(mapping_rule_version),normalization_version=VALUES(normalization_version), masking_status=VALUES(masking_status),data_quality_score=VALUES(data_quality_score), quality_rule_version=VALUES(quality_rule_version),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
